long_biography.plain_text:
John J. Harned Jr. brought Indian River Transport back under family ownership a decade after his father Jack sold the trucking company. Founded in Florida in 1974, it specialised in carrying liquid food products. Harned reacquired it from a British transport group in 1993 and led its subsequent growth from Winter Haven into a major food-grade tanker carrier.

The company now moves fruit juices, dairy and other liquid commodities in dedicated tankers throughout the United States, with cross-border services to Canada and Mexico. Its published fleet numbers more than 600 tractors and 1,200 trailers. Industry recognition has identified Harned as its president, chief executive and owner.
